verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Authenticator has an App Lock feature and export/password features, and mentions that admins can allow/disallow notifications or restrict which MFA methods (e.g., TOTP vs push) are permitted at the tenant level, but there is no evidence of an admin console or policy mechanism to specifically mandate App Lock, restrict export, or enforce strong master credentials across all org members. Community comments even suggest admins lack fine-grained control tools (comm-6).
